data.seo_description: Photography for churches, schools, nonprofits and small businesses around Cincinnati: events, portraits and spaces, from $900 for a half day.
data.cta_sub: Day-of coverage, headshots, environments. Often paired with web work, sometimes booked on its own.
data.heading: Photography that matches the
data.intro: Events, portraits, and spaces for organizations around Cincinnati, often shot for the website I am building at the same time, so the photos and the site look like one piece of work.
data.events_intro: Sunday mornings, school assemblies, fundraisers, ribbon cuttings. Coverage that tells the story without making the room perform for the camera.
data.portraits_intro: Team headshots, staff portraits, leadership pages. Comfortable lighting, consistent treatment, edited for web so the file size stays sane.
data.environments_intro: Lobbies, classrooms, sanctuaries, storefronts. The spaces visitors actually walk into, photographed in the light they actually see.
data.empty_heading: A public gallery is on its way.
data.empty_body: I am gathering the best frames from recent church, school and small-business shoots, with each client's permission. Until then, ask and I will send samples that fit your project.
